title: Ember Vigil
tagline: Keep your lantern lit and survive the winter night.
summary: A survival roguelite in a dark Nordic forest. You move, your rune weapons fire by themselves, and dawn is seven minutes away.
about: Monsters pour out of the winter forest and you have one job: keep your lantern burning until dawn. You only steer. Your weapons fire on their own, so every decision is where to stand and which upgrade to take next.

Collect blue crystals to level up and build your own mix of burning bolts, a ring of embers, firepots, Tyr's spear and northern lights that chain between enemies. Max out a weapon, pair it with the right blessing and open a chest to evolve it into something far stronger.

Every run earns embers, even when you fall. Spend them on permanent upgrades and new heroes, then head back out and last a little longer. Survive a night to unlock the next one. There are ten, each harder than the last.
features: 3 bosses, from a fell troll to the Frost Giant

title: Snowfeud
tagline: Penguin artillery. Beat the bot, or duel a friend over a link.
summary: Two penguin teams, two snowy hills and a mountain in between. Drag back, mind the wind and bury the other side in snow.
about: Two teams of penguins face each other across the snow with a mountain in the way. Drag back to aim, let go to throw, and read the wind before every shot. Bury the whole enemy team to win.
Play the bot and work your way through three rivals: The Rookie, The Pro and The Legend. Your first match unlocks six special weapons, walking and switching penguins.
Or challenge a friend. Take your shot, send the link, and they fire back from their own phone. There are no accounts and nothing to install. The whole match travels inside the link.
features: Three bot rivals to beat in order
Friend duels played over shared links
controls: Drag back with the mouse, release

facts.Players: 1 vs bot, or 2 over a link

title: GolfFeud
tagline: Play a hole, send the link, and your friend chases your ghost.
summary: Nine-hole golf duels. Pick a club, drag back to swing and add backspin or topspin to stop it on the green.
about: GolfFeud is golf you play against a ghost. Play a hole, send the link, and your friend plays the same hole with your round replaying beside them, shot for shot. Fewest strokes takes the hole. Nine holes settle the feud.
Choose between driver, iron, wedge and putter, then drag back anywhere to swing. Backspin bites on landing and topspin runs. Mind the wind, the water, the sand and the rough.
No friend around? Play the bot. The Rookie, The Pro and The Legend each play a full nine-hole match against you.
features: 9-hole matches with fresh holes every round
controls: Drag back with the mouse, release

title: Ålandsflyg
tagline: Fly bush planes, airliners and an air ambulance over the real Åland.
summary: A flight simulator over Åland and the Stockholm and Turku archipelagos, built from real satellite and elevation data.
about: Take off from Mariehamn and fly over the real Åland: forests, fields, bare rock, lakes and towns from satellite data, terrain from elevation models, and every road, building and lighthouse from OpenStreetMap. The map reaches all the way to Stockholm and Turku.

Choose between five aircraft: a bush plane on wheels, a seaplane on floats, a twin turboprop, an airliner with fly-by-wire and a yellow air ambulance helicopter. Eight missions include medevac flights as far out as Kökar.
New to flying? The first flight walks you through takeoff, turns and landing. A landing guide shows the glide path and the speed to hold, and every touchdown gets up to three stars.
features: 5 aircraft, from a bush plane to an airliner
Real airports: Mariehamn, Arlanda, Bromma, Turku
Weather, clouds and six times of day
controls: Drag the lever on the left
